sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
Our order history for this part shows 4.12 EUR (po:4500010043-10) against 4.39 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014467-10).
Our volume forecast for this part is up 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 85.0% (sc:70620@2026Q3).
Today you supply 70 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 12-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 20,000 pcs per year over 12 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your response and the volume commitment. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position.

Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our colleagues will provide the requested information regarding the cost breakdown.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months. We can accept the 14-day payment term you proposed, and in return, we can offer a slight adjustment to €4.95 per unit, which gives an alternative package of a price of €4.95 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 12 months.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We acknowledge your revised offer and your willingness to accommodate a 14-day payment term. In response, we can make a minimal adjustment to €4.94 per unit for this package. 

Our current proposition stands at a price of €5.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months. Please understand that further reductions are not feasible given our current operational constraints. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 12 months.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
